# Appropriation Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2013

**An Appropriation Ordinance Enacting the Pre-Closing Special Budget for the Fiscal Year Ended December 31, 2012 — P702,830.57**

## Summary

Enacts the Pre-Closing Special Budget for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2012, appropriating **P702,830.57** sourced from savings from various offices of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]].

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1:** At close of business December 31, 2012, a portion of savings from unexpended appropriations totals P702,830.57
- **Section 2:** P702,830.57 is appropriated to cover overstall
- **Section 3:** Pre-Closing Budget is attached as Annex A

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Dante L. Punac Sr.]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
- [[Municipal Budget Office]]
- [[Municipal Treasurer's Office]]

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-316-RA7160]] — General limitations on the use of provincial, city, and municipal funds
- [[Sec-447-RA7160]] — Powers, duties, functions of the Sangguniang Bayan
